Lemma
[Hessian square norm as a trace along the gradient]

↗ def:hessian-norm-sq ↗ lem:hessian-symmetric

Let $G=( abla f)^*$, let $(e_i)$ be an orthonormal basis at $p$, and extend it to fields $E_i$. For every field $X$ and $w\in T_pM$, \[ \langle ( abla _XG)(p),w angle =\Hess (f)_p(X(p),w), \] and \[ \sum _i\langle abla _{ abla _{E_i}G}G,E_i angle (p) =|\Hess (f)|^2(p). \]
Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:hessian-symmetric

The first identity is the Riesz form of the Hessian-gradient formula. Writing $ abla _{E_i}G=\sum _j\Hess (f)(e_i,e_j)e_j$ at $p$ and using Hessian symmetry turns the trace into the defining sum of squares.

□
